append.description: Adds a single item to the end of the list, in place.

extend.description: Adds all items from an iterable to the end of the list, in place.

insert.description: Inserts an item at the given index, shifting later items to the right.

remove.description: Removes the first item equal to value; raises ValueError if it isn't found.

pop.description: Removes and returns the item at index (the last item by default).

clear.description: Removes all items from the list, in place.

index.description: Returns the index of the first item equal to value; raises ValueError if not found.

count.description: Returns how many times value appears in the list.

reverse.description: Reverses the order of the list, in place.

copy.description: Returns a shallow copy of the list as a new, separate object.
